scope: Report rationale only. No patient rows, model weights or clinical frequency cutoffs imported.

sources.title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook: Box Plot
sources.supports: Quartiles and the interquartile range summarize variation; 1.5-IQR and 3-IQR fences are described for outlier exploration.
sources.does_not_support: The project's appliance-specific count floors, score weights, 1.0/2.0-IQR settings or clinical diagnostic validity.

sources.title: Alzheimer's Society: Repetitive behaviour and dementia
sources.supports: Repeated fridge checking is an example; memory, reassurance, triggers and personal context can matter.
sources.does_not_support: A numeric fridge-opening frequency, five-minute interval or appliance-only diagnostic rule.

inference_boundary: These sources support the statistical approach and observation hypothesis, not validation of this system's clinical thresholds.
